hero.description: I design and build high-performance, scalable web applications. Specializing in modern frontend interfaces and robust backend architectures to deliver seamless digital experiences.

about.headline: Who is Amarjeet Kumar?
paragraphs: I am a passionate Full-Stack Software Engineer who loves turning complex problems into elegant, robust digital solutions. With solid experience across the MERN (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) stack, I build applications that are not only performant and secure but also feature highly interactive and fluid user interfaces.

My engineering philosophy revolves around writing clean, modular, and maintainable code. I focus heavily on application lifecycle optimization, API efficiency, database scaling, and responsive design patterns that satisfy modern product needs.
When I'm not coding, you can find me exploring open-source repositories on GitHub, debugging infrastructure workflows, or reading about next-gen web standards and microservice architectures.
about.ctaDesc: I am always excited to discuss new projects, engineering systems, or integration opportunities.

projects.title: DevCanvas
projects.subtitle: Collaborative Developer Workspace
projects.description: A real-time collaborative workspace for developers, featuring interactive canvas whiteboards, synchronized code snippets, and group chat channels. Engineered using WebSockets for sub-100ms latency synchronization.

projects.title: ShopFlow
projects.subtitle: Full-Stack E-Commerce Platform
projects.description: A robust e-commerce suite featuring persistent shopping states, secure checkouts, admin inventory controls, and automated transaction email receipts. Built with secure payment gateways and relational schemas.

projects.title: TaskPulse
projects.subtitle: Agile Workspace & Analytics
projects.description: An agile project planner featuring interactive Kanban boards, sprint tracking calendars, and analytics dashboards visualizing completion rates. Powered by custom drag-and-drop lists and chart APIs.
